title: DEFICIT
description: Late-night bus-stop surrealism: while waiting for the last bus of the night, an eccentric, socially awkward server tries to make conversation with the mysterious suited man beside him — and things get increasingly bizarre and surreal, set to a custom-composed score performed by real session musicians. Written, directed, and starring Jacob Willett, with Gabe Zendejas as DP, editor, and colorist — made on a budget under $200. One of two shorts, alongside Hang-Ups, that got Jacob into SDSU's film production program.
